About the Role


The Cloud Operations Engineer will provide hands-on operational support across Eightpoint's multi-cloud infrastructure spanning AWS and GCP. This role focuses on maintaining reliability, supporting CI/CD pipelines, and ensuring observability across all environments while enabling the DevOps team to focus on project-driven initiatives. The position reports to the Director of IT & Cybersecurity and works closely with the DevOps and Systems Administration teams.

  • Support GCP workloads, primarily BigQuery pipelines and related data infrastructure.

  • Deploy, configure, and maintain logging, monitoring, and alerting tooling (Grafana stack — Loki, Tempo, Mimir, Alloy; CloudWatch; OneUptime).
  • Manage infrastructure-as-code using Terraform.
  • Participate in on-call rotation providing support across US and offshore time zones.
  • Contribute to documentation in Confluence and maintain runbooks for operational procedures.

  • 5+ years of experience in a cloud operations, DevOps, or infrastructure support role.
  • Strong working knowledge of AWS core services (EKS, Elastic Beanstalk, EC2, S3, IAM, VPC, RDS, CloudFront).
  • Hands-on experience administering containerized workloads (Kubernetes/EKS, Docker).
  • Experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines in GitHub Actions.
  • Demonstrated experience with incident response workflows — detection, escalation, remediation, and RCA.
  • Experience deploying and maintaining observability tooling (logging, metrics, tracing, alerting).
  • Proficiency in Linux administration and shell scripting (Bash, Python).
  • Strong experience with Terraform for infrastructure-as-code.
  • Experience with Atlassian tooling (Jira, JSM, Confluence).


Preferred Qualifications


  • Experience with GCP, specifically BigQuery and related data services.
  • Experience with Grafana OSS stack (Loki, Tempo, Mimir, Alloy/Faro).
  • Experience supporting Airflow or similar orchestration platforms.
  • AWS certifications (Solutions Architect Associate, SysOps, or DevOps Engineer).
  • Experience working in multi-account AWS environments with consolidated billing/cost allocation tagging.
  • Exposure to ZTNA/VPN solutions (Firezone, Twingate, or similar).

title: Institutional Relations Manager
description:
Founded in 1948, Karadeniz Holding is a visionary industry leader that focuses on innovation while supporting growth with an emphasis on economic and environmental sustainability across a wide range of industries, primarily energy and shipbuilding.


Operating in more than 20 countries, with over 3,000 employees from 30 different nationalities and an installed capacity exceeding 8,000 MW, the Group generates reliable and clean electricity across four continents through its fleet of 45 Powerships™ and 11 LNG vessels, providing employment to more than 10,000 people worldwide. Karadeniz Holding manages its Powership™ fleet under its international brand Karpowership, meeting between 10% and 100% of the electricity needs of the countries where it operates across Europe, Africa, the Americas, and Asia. With high-capacity energy solutions, including Powership™, land-based plants, and floating LNG infrastructure, Karpowership supports countries and companies in their energy transition processes.


We are looking for an Institutional Relations Manager to join our operations in Brazil, based at our Rio de Janeiro office.


WHAT DO WE EXPECT?


• Bachelor’s degree in Law, Economics, Engineering, Business Administration or related fields; postgraduate degree or MBA will be considered a plus,

• Minimum of 8 years of experience in institutional, governmental, or regulatory affairs, preferably within the energy sector (power generation, natural gas, oil & gas, or infrastructure),

• Strong knowledge of the Brazilian regulatory environment, especially in the electricity and natural gas sectors, including interaction with entities such as ANEEL, ONS, and MME,

• Proven experience in managing relationships with key stakeholders (government, regulators, associations, and institutional partners),

• Advanced English (spoken and written),

• Strong communication, negotiation, and influencing skills in complex and multicultural environments,

• Analytical mindset with the ability to interpret regulatory scenarios and anticipate risks and opportunities,

• Leadership skills, project management capabilities, and ability to work cross-functionally,

• Ability to work under pressure, manage multiple priorities, and handle strategic topics,

• High ethical standards and alignment with compliance and corporate governance practices,

• Proactive profile with autonomy and ability to develop strategic and innovative solutions.


WHAT AWAITS YOU?


• Lead and execute KPS Brazil’s institutional and governmental relations strategy, ensuring alignment with business and regulatory objectives,

• Develop and maintain strategic relationships with government bodies, regulators, and industry entities, including ANEEL, ONS, MME, IBAMA, and other relevant stakeholders,

• Continuously monitor and analyze the regulatory and institutional landscape of the electricity and natural gas sectors in Brazil, anticipating risks and opportunities,

• Proactively represent and defend the company’s interests in public consultations, hearings, and regulatory forums,

• Coordinate licensing processes, authorizations, and institutional interactions required for project implementation, operation, and continuity (including Powerships and onshore assets),

• Structure and implement stakeholder engagement strategies at local, regional, and national levels, including governments, communities, and strategic partners,

• Support institutional and contractual negotiations with public authorities and regulatory bodies, ensuring legal compliance and risk mitigation,

• Work closely with legal, regulatory, commercial, and operational teams to ensure consistency in the company’s institutional positioning,

• Manage institutional crises and sensitive matters, ensuring effective communication and strategic positioning,

• Lead the preparation of strategic reports and executive analyses on the regulatory and institutional environment to support senior leadership decision-making,

• Represent the company in industry associations, chambers of commerce, and energy sector forums, strengthening KPS’s institutional presence in Brazil,

• Ensure compliance with corporate governance, ethics, and compliance guidelines in all institutional interactions.


WHAT DO WE OFFER?


• Hybrid working model,

• One day off on your birthday,

• Private health insurance (extended to dependents) and life insurance,

• Variable compensation package and performance-based bonus,

• Meal allowance + food allowance in line with market practices,

• Mobility benefits (transport allowance and parking policy),

• Well-being and quality of life programs, including TotalPass,

• Professional and personal training and development opportunities,

• Multicultural environment with exposure to international projects,

• Opportunity to contribute to strategic energy transition projects.


In line with our \"One World\" philosophy, we are adding success to our achievements with our colleagues, candidates, and all stakeholders. We are committed to providing equal opportunities for all applicants, regardless of race, religion, language or gender and we crown our success with our diversity.


In accordance with the Brazilian General Data Protection Law – LGPD (Law No. 13,709/2018), we kindly ask you to review our Privacy Notice for detailed information regarding the processing of your personal data.

description:
Digital Business Analyst – Shape the Future of Energy Reporting & Operations!


We are recruiting on behalf of a global energy services organisation operating across Gas & Power Services. This programme sits at the heart of operational excellence, regulatory compliance, and customer transparency - replacing fragmented, manual reporting with a scalable digital reporting solution across complex industrial assets.


You’ll join a long-term, high-impact transformation programme focused on power plant operations, Operations & Maintenance (O&M), and performance reporting. This is a discovery-heavy role with real ownership, working directly with senior stakeholders to define what the product should be, before it’s built.


As a Digital Business Analyst, you’ll lead domain discovery, define product capabilities, and act as the bridge between business stakeholders and delivery teams to turn complex operational needs into a clear, scalable digital solution.


Your Role:

You’ll be the bridge between operations, data, and delivery. This is a senior, hands-on role where you’ll rapidly onboard into the Gas & Power Services domain, lead structured discovery, and shape a digital reporting product from the ground up - with ownership through to delivery and value realisation.


What You’ll Do:

  • Lead structured interviews and workshops with domain heads and SMEs to capture current-state (“as-is”) processes, data flows, and pain points
  • Translate business needs into clear product capabilities, outcomes, and success measures
  • Define reporting requirements, data inputs, ownership models, and KPIs across performance, efficiency, safety, environmental, and financial metrics
  • Balance standardisation and configurability across plants, equipment types, and markets
  • Create and maintain product vision, roadmap, capability maps, and a prioritised backlog
  • Define the end-to-end data and reporting strategy - from data collection and validation through to dashboards and customer-facing outputs
  • Work closely with Solution Architects to ensure technical feasibility, scalability, and long-term sustainability
  • Act as the primary bridge between business stakeholders and delivery teams, driving clarity and momentum
  • Lead demos, clarify scope boundaries, and align expectations on custom vs configurable functionality
  • Support planning, estimation, sequencing, and governance across a multi-phase programme

title: Specialist AI Engineer / Builder (LLM & Healthcare) | 100% Remoto
description:
O DESAFIO:

A cada ano, o setor de saúde perde bilhões por falhas no faturamento. Nós somos o elo perdido que resolve esse gap com IA. Estamos em plena expansão , com operações reais, clientes ativos e novos parceiros no pipeline. Buscamos um Builder para transformar nosso produto atual em uma plataforma de escala global.

Aqui, autonomia, responsabilidade e protagonismo são nossa vivência diária. Não buscamos pessoas prontas; não saber tudo faz parte do processo. O que valorizamos é a curiosidade investigativa e o desejo genuíno de aprender.


Você atuará do operacional ao estratégico : da mão no código à tomada de decisão. É o perfil que propõe novos modelos e identifica oportunidades de receita, mas que também valida dados manualmente para garantir que a solução seja impecável. Atitude, velocidade e senso de urgência são os motores que impulsionam nossa entrega.


PRINCIPAIS RESPONSABILIDADES:

Sua missão é liderar a transição tecnológica da nossa inteligência:


• O Agora (Execução e Precisão):

  • Refinar e otimizar modelos em produção (AWS Bedrock), elevando constantemente os níveis de acurácia e performance.
  • Garantir precisão absoluta \"batendo\" dados e regras manualmente; em saúde, a qualidade do dado é inegociável.
  • Monitorar padrões de negativas (denials) e implementar loops de correção imediatos para que o sistema aprenda em tempo real.


• O Futuro (Escala e Arquitetura):

  • Evoluir nossa infraestrutura para um ecossistema robusto de RAGs e bancos vetoriais .
  • Migrar de uma solução centralizada para uma malha de modelos especializados por contexto e seguradora.
  • Contribuir para o fine-tuning de modelos próprios , utilizando nossos dados históricos para criar uma vantagem competitiva única.


O QUE BUSCAMOS:

  • Curiosidade Investigativa: Desejo genuíno de aprender e decifrar as regras complexas do faturamento médico. Você não precisa vir da saúde, mas precisa querer dominá-la.
  • Atitude e Senso de Urgência: Valorizamos a velocidade e a proatividade. Em nosso contexto de negócio, a capacidade de entrega rápida é vital.
  • Mão no Código: Experiência prática sólida com Python ou Go e APIs de LLM (OpenAI, Anthropic, Bedrock).
  • Mentalidade de Builder: Capacidade de construir sistemas robustos do zero e obsessão pelo detalhe (não descansa enquanto a automação não reflete a regra de negócio com precisão cirúrgica).


O QUE OFERECEMOS

  • Oportunidade em Estágio Inicial: Chance de ser um dos primeiros membros de uma empresa em rápida expansão, com impacto direto na arquitetura e cultura.
  • Desafio Técnico de Alto Nível: Resolver problemas reais usando o estado da arte em IA Generativa.

title: Senior Studio Specialist
description:
JoVE is the world-leading producer and provider of science video solutions with the mission to improve scientific research and education. Millions of scientists, educators and students use JoVE for their research, teaching and learning. Our institutional clients comprise over 1,000 universities, colleges, and biopharma companies, including such leaders as Harvard, MIT, Yale, and Stanford. As a rapidly growing company, with offices in the USA, UK, Australia, and India servicing clients in over 60 countries, we are seeking talented and ambitious individuals to join our company.


The Role


As a Senior Studio Specialist at JoVE , you will drive the operational excellence of our in-house creative studio. You will execute and oversee project execution, optimize workflows, and introduce AI-powered solutions to enhance efficiency, quality, and scalability.

This is a senior, hands-on role for someone who understands the full creative production lifecycle and thrives in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment - a love for science is a plus!


Responsibilities:

  • Oversee and coordinate the execution of creative projects from brief to final delivery
  • Maintain the studio production schedule and assign projects to the in-house motion graphics team based on availability, timelines, and project scope.
  • Track the day-to-day progress of projects in the pipeline, follow up on deadlines, flag delays, and ensure workload distribution supports on-time delivery.
  • Define and track KPIs, deadlines, and performance metrics to ensure smooth production cycles
  • Work closely with the Director of Marketing to translate business objectives into actionable creative plans
  • Collaborate with internal stakeholders to refine briefs and propose effective design solutions
  • Create and edit high-quality video assets to support marketing campaigns, product launches, digital initiatives, and brand awareness efforts.
  • Design, document, and continuously improve studio workflows and cross-functional processes
  • Ensure brand consistency and creative quality standards across all deliverables
  • Identify bottlenecks and implement scalable improvements to increase efficiency
  • Lead the integration of AI technologies into creative workflows, including automation, asset generation, project tracking, and quality optimization


Requirements:

  • 5–7 years of experience in creative production, studio coordination, or motion graphics environments
  • Proven ability to manage multiple concurrent creative projects while ensuring quality and on-time delivery
  • Strong experience supporting and improving production workflows within creative teams
  • Demonstrated ability to coordinate designers and balance workloads effectively in a fast-paced environment
  • Proficiency with project management tools such as Asana (or similar platforms)
  • Hands-on experience leveraging AI tools to improve production efficiency and creative output
  • Strong attention to detail and quality control across all stages of the creative process
  • Excellent communication skills and ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional stakeholders
  • Solid understanding of the end-to-end creative production lifecycle (briefing, design, review, revisions, final delivery)


Why Join JoVE?

  • You will make a direct impact in accelerating science research and education.
  • Opportunity to work with global teams and in an environment that promotes innovation and collaboration.
  • Our strong promotion from within culture draws a clear path to advance your career with us.

title: Emerging market trader
description:
Role OverviewWe are seeking a highly skilled Emerging Markets FX Trader with deep expertise in African and/or Latin American currencies to join our global trading & liquidity team. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience managing illiquid and restricted FX markets, executing OTC and interbank trades, and designing robust hedging and liquidity frameworks to support high-volume cross-border payment flows. This role requires both strong trading capability and infrastructure expertise, including building and optimizing FX trading systems, hedging engines, and liquidity connectivity with banks, brokers, and OTC counterparties.
Key Responsibilities
FX Trading & Liquidity Management
Manage proprietary and flow-driven FX trading positions across Emerging Market currencies, with a focus on African (e.g., NGN, KES, ZAR, GHS) or LATAM (e.g., BRL, MXN, COP, ARS) markets.
Source and maintain deep liquidity relationships with banks, brokers, and OTC desks across relevant regions.
Execute spot, forwards, NDFs, swaps, and OTC trades to optimize execution quality and manage currency exposure.
Monitor market developments, capital controls, and liquidity dynamics across EM FX markets.
Hedging Strategy & Risk Management
Design and implement FX hedging strategies to manage corporate or client-driven exposures.
Optimize hedging efficiency across multiple liquidity venues including banks, ECNs, OTC desks, and crypto liquidity pools where relevant.
Develop models for dynamic hedging, inventory risk management, and spread optimization.
Monitor risk limits, Pn L, and exposure across currency books.
Trading Infrastructure & Systems
Work closely with engineering and product teams to build and enhance FX trading and hedging infrastructure, including:
Automated hedging engines
Liquidity aggregation systems
Smart order routing
Pricing and risk management tools
Integrate connectivity with banks, ECNs, and liquidity providers via APIs or FIX protocols.
Improve execution automation, latency optimization, and real-time exposure monitoring.
Market Development
Identify and onboard new liquidity providers and OTC trading partners across emerging markets.
Build pricing frameworks for illiquid currency pairs and support new corridor launches.
Contribute to the development of scalable FX infrastructure supporting global payments and settlement flows.
Requirements
Experience
5–10+ years of FX trading experience in Emerging Markets.
Strong experience trading African or LATAM currencies, such as:
Africa: NGN, KES, ZAR, GHS, EGP
LATAM: BRL, MXN, COP, CLP, ARS
Experience working at:
Global banks
EM FX trading firms
Payment / fintech companies
Crypto exchanges or market makers
Proven experience executing OTC and institutional-sized FX trades.
Technical Expertise
Deep understanding of:
FX market microstructure in illiquid markets
NDF markets and offshore hedging
Capital controls and FX regulatory frameworks
Hands-on experience building or optimizing:
FX trading systems
Hedging engines
Liquidity aggregation platforms
Familiarity with FIX connectivity, API-based trading systems, and algorithmic execution.
Skills
Strong quantitative and analytical capabilities.
Ability to operate in high-volatility and fragmented liquidity environments.
Strong network within EM FX liquidity providers and OTC trading desks.
Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience supporting high-volume cross-border payment flows or treasury operations.
Experience trading EM FX through both traditional banks and alternative liquidity sources.
Familiarity with stablecoin / crypto liquidity markets in emerging economies.
Background in building or scaling FX market-making operations.
Strong analytical and problem solving skills
Ability to operate across global teams and fast paced environments
Vision & Mission
OSL is the first SFC-licensed digital asset platform in Hong Kong and a Pay Fi innovator. Through stablecoin payments, cross-border settlement and global licensing, we are building the next-generation payments network. Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain's "killer app," with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption. The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2 B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners and cross-border corridors.
OSL holds or has acquired licences in Hong Kong, Japan, Australia, Bermuda and Indonesia, and is expanding into Europe, Brazil, Southeast Asia and Africa through acquisitions and licence applications. With OSL Pay and Stable X, we embed stablecoin settlement into bank accounts and card networks, support 150+ digital assets, and provide 24/7 fiat–stablecoin conversion. As a regulated pioneer with a startup mindset, we believe the future of payments will be driven by real adoption and scalable deployment, not technology narratives. We welcome builders who are passionate about crypto and payments to join us in shaping compliant, global payment infrastructure.

title: Technical expert
description:
At Etex, our purpose is to inspire new ways of living.
We are an international leader in sustainable construction, driven by a passion for excellence, but it's our people that are our top priority.
We connect, collaborate, and champion the well-being of our employees, forming partnerships and pioneering change in our ever-evolving industry.
At Etex, we seek to make a meaningful impact on the lives of our customers and our communities.
Are you looking for a company where you can learn, grow and lead? Join us as an Technical Expert for Brazil, based in Río de Janeiro! The mission of the role is act as the key technical interface in large-scale industrial projects across South America, ensuring equipment specifications, installation, and performance meet Etex standards and international norms.
The role safeguards project delivery in terms of safety, timing, and budget, while supporting project managers and coordinating with suppliers, local teams, and stakeholders.
What you’ll do Develop technical specifications for equipment purchases and installations, aligned with Etex standards and customer requirements.
Review and align supplier proposals with international and group standards.
Monitor the full project lifecycle: engineering studies, manufacturing, acceptance tests, commissioning, start-up, and closure.
Supervise erection works on-site, ensuring safety and timely execution.
Provide recommendations to stakeholders to support decision-making.
Act as the interface between suppliers, local customers, operational teams, and project managers.
Support project managers with PMO methodology and reporting.
Manage budget responsibilities depending on project size.
Communicate effectively with multicultural teams and suppliers, maintaining leadership and authority.
What you’ll bring Engineering degree or confirmed technician background in mechanics or electricity/automation; knowledge of construction/civil works is a plus.
Minimum of 10 years’ experience in technical fields, with appetite for managing large technical projects.
Strong technical expertise in mechanics/electricity; proficiency in Auto CAD and MS Office.
PMP certification or equivalent is a plus.
Language skills: fluent English mandatory.
Strong communication skills and ability to challenge suppliers constructively.
Flexibility, resilience, and autonomy under remote management (Europe-based).
Ability to work collaboratively, avoiding silo mentality.
Why join us? We are named the world's #1 most trustworthy company in the construction sector by Newsweek and Statista in 2023! Our culture – we connect & care about those around us.
We nurture teamwork, communities, partnerships and new ways of working, placing the highest importance on the safety and working environment of our people.
Our ‘Road to Sustainability 2030’ is our plan to help build a better, sustainable future.
We work towards this vision by caring about our social and environmental impacts and developing innovative solutions We have a strong conviction that diversity of thinking helps us to deliver a strong and sustainable performance.
It is also essential for us that everyone feels part of the team.
In this spirit, we are committed to equal opportunities and zero tolerance towards discrimination Flexibility: For us, hybrid and flexible working is all about trust, and we want you to be able to do your best work (depending on the role).

title: Especialista de arquitetura e implantação | expansão
description:
Descrição da vaga No Azzas 2154 Fashion & Lifestyle, somos movidos por pessoas.
São elas que impulsionam ideias, constroem marcas e fazem a moda acontecer todos os dias.
Aqui, cada pessoa tem voz, espaço e responsabilidade na construção do que fazemos.
É assim, todos os dias, que nos tornamos o maior Grupo de Moda da América Latina.
Buscamos um perfil estratégico e multidisciplinar para atuar no coração da expansão do Grupo F&L.
Você será responsável por gerenciar a arquitetura e a implantação de lojas para diversas marcas do portfólio, garantindo que cada conceito criativo seja traduzido em espaços viáveis, rentáveis e escaláveis.
É uma posição de alta visibilidade, que exige trânsito entre o criativo e o financeiro, com foco em excelência operacional.
Responsabilidades e atribuições Desenvolvimento de Conceito Multimarca: Colaborar com os times criativos de cada marca (Reserva, Sprint, Oficina, etc.) para refinar conceitos arquitetônicos, garantindo que a execução seja fiel ao DNA de cada marca e economicamente viável.
Engenharia de Valor e Escalabilidade: Analisar criticamente os projetos para garantir que as soluções sejam escaláveis (rollout), definindo padrões técnicos que otimizem prazos e custos sem comprometer a estética.
Gestão de Implantação e Obras: Liderar o ciclo completo de obras e reformas de todo o portfólio do grupo, do planejamento inicial à entrega das chaves.
Interface Estratégica com Administradoras: Atuar como interlocutor técnico sênior junto aos grandes players de shopping ( Multiplan, Allos, Ancar, etc.
), negociando cadernos técnicos e prazos de aprovação.
Gestão de CAPEX e Parceiros: Equalizar orçamentos, realizar a precificação junto a parceiros estratégicos e garantir que cada inauguração respeite as metas financeiras do Grupo.
Homologação e Fiscalização: Selecionar e gerenciar fornecedores e empreiteiras, realizando visitas técnicas para garantir a qualidade de entrega e o cumprimento dos cronogramas.
Legalização: Coordenar os processos de obtenção de alvarás e licenças, garantindo a conformidade de todas as unidades do grupo.
Requisitos e qualificações Formação: Superior completo em Arquitetura e Urbanismo (preferencial) ou Engenharia Civil.
Experiência: Sólida bagagem em implantação de varejo, preferencialmente com experiência em gestão de múltiplas marcas simultâneas.
Bagagem de Mercado: Experiência em marcas que são referências em conceito e experiência de loja ou em grandes administradoras de shoppings é um diferencial importante.
Soft Skills Inegociáveis: * Comunicação e Articulação: Habilidade para escrever e falar com clareza, influenciando parceiros externos e reportando resultados para a liderança.
Autonomia e Proatividade: Perfil "dono do negócio", capaz de gerir múltiplos cronogramas e tomar decisões rápidas em cenários de obra.
Organização: Disciplina para gerenciar orçamentos e prazos de diferentes marcas ao mesmo tempo.
Ferramentas: Domínio de Auto Cad e Pacote Office (Excel avançado para controle de CAPEX).
Mobilidade: Residir no Rio de Janeiro e ter disponibilidade para viagens.
Informações adicionais NOSSOS BENEFÍCIOS No Azzas 2154 Fashion & Lifestyle, acreditamos que cuidar das pessoas é parte essencial para construir o maior Grupo de Moda da América Latina.
Por isso, oferecemos um conjunto de benefícios pensado para apoiar o bem-estar, o desenvolvimento e o dia a dia de quem faz parte da nossa história.
Saúde e bem estar • Plano de saúde • Plano odontológico • Seguro de vida • Programas de bem-estar físico, como Wellhub ou Total Pass • Iniciativas de apoio à saúde mental Dia a dia e qualidade de vida • Benefícios flexíveis por meio de cartão Flash • Vale transporte • Day off de aniversário • Extensão de licença maternidade • Extensão de licença paternidade • Descontos nas marcas do grupo Desenvolvimento e crescimento • Programas de capacitação e desenvolvimento • Trilhas de aprendizagem corporativas • Iniciativas de reconhecimento e engajamento Reconhecimento • Participação nos resultados, conforme política vigente * Os benefícios podem variar de acordo com o cargo, a unidade e as políticas internas da companhia.

title: Institutional relations manager
description:
Founded in 1948, Karadeniz Holding is a visionary industry leader that focuses on innovation while supporting growth with an emphasis on economic and environmental sustainability across a wide range of industries, primarily energy and shipbuilding.
Operating in more than 20 countries, with over 3,000 employees from 30 different nationalities and an installed capacity exceeding 8,000 MW, the Group generates reliable and clean electricity across four continents through its fleet of 45 Powerships TM and 11 LNG vessels, providing employment to more than 10,000 people worldwide. Karadeniz Holding manages its Powership TM fleet under its international brand Karpowership, meeting between 10% and 100% of the electricity needs of the countries where it operates across Europe, Africa, the Americas, and Asia. With high-capacity energy solutions, including Powership TM, land-based plants, and floating LNG infrastructure, Karpowership supports countries and companies in their energy transition processes.
We are looking for an Institutional Relations Manager to join our operations in Brazil, based at our Rio de Janeiro office.
WHAT DO WE EXPECT?
• Bachelor's degree in Law, Economics, Engineering, Business Administration or related fields; postgraduate degree or MBA will be considered a plus,
• Minimum of 8 years of experience in institutional, governmental, or regulatory affairs, preferably within the energy sector (power generation, natural gas, oil & gas, or infrastructure),
• Strong knowledge of the Brazilian regulatory environment, especially in the electricity and natural gas sectors, including interaction with entities such as ANEEL, ONS, and MME,
• Proven experience in managing relationships with key stakeholders (government, regulators, associations, and institutional partners),
• Advanced English (spoken and written),
• Strong communication, negotiation, and influencing skills in complex and multicultural environments,
• Analytical mindset with the ability to interpret regulatory scenarios and anticipate risks and opportunities,
• Leadership skills, project management capabilities, and ability to work cross-functionally,
• Ability to work under pressure, manage multiple priorities, and handle strategic topics,
• High ethical standards and alignment with compliance and corporate governance practices,
• Proactive profile with autonomy and ability to develop strategic and innovative solutions.
WHAT AWAITS YOU?
• Lead and execute KPS Brazil's institutional and governmental relations strategy, ensuring alignment with business and regulatory objectives,
• Develop and maintain strategic relationships with government bodies, regulators, and industry entities, including ANEEL, ONS, MME, IBAMA, and other relevant stakeholders,
• Continuously monitor and analyze the regulatory and institutional landscape of the electricity and natural gas sectors in Brazil, anticipating risks and opportunities,
• Proactively represent and defend the company's interests in public consultations, hearings, and regulatory forums,
• Coordinate licensing processes, authorizations, and institutional interactions required for project implementation, operation, and continuity (including Powerships and onshore assets),
• Structure and implement stakeholder engagement strategies at local, regional, and national levels, including governments, communities, and strategic partners,
• Support institutional and contractual negotiations with public authorities and regulatory bodies, ensuring legal compliance and risk mitigation,
• Work closely with legal, regulatory, commercial, and operational teams to ensure consistency in the company's institutional positioning,
• Manage institutional crises and sensitive matters, ensuring effective communication and strategic positioning,
• Lead the preparation of strategic reports and executive analyses on the regulatory and institutional environment to support senior leadership decision-making,
• Represent the company in industry associations, chambers of commerce, and energy sector forums, strengthening KPS's institutional presence in Brazil,
• Ensure compliance with corporate governance, ethics, and compliance guidelines in all institutional interactions.
WHAT DO WE OFFER?
• Hybrid working model,
• One day off on your birthday,
• Private health insurance (extended to dependents) and life insurance,
• Variable compensation package and performance-based bonus,
• Meal allowance + food allowance in line with market practices,
• Mobility benefits (transport allowance and parking policy),
• Well-being and quality of life programs, including Total Pass,
• Professional and personal training and development opportunities,
• Multicultural environment with exposure to international projects,
• Opportunity to contribute to strategic energy transition projects.
In line with our " One World" philosophy, we are adding success to our achievements with our colleagues, candidates, and all stakeholders. We are committed to providing equal opportunities for all applicants, regardless of race, religion, language or gender and we crown our success with our diversity.
In accordance with the Brazilian General Data Protection Law – LGPD (Law No. 13,709/2018), we kindly ask you to review our Privacy Notice for detailed information regarding the processing of your personal data.

title: Técnico em segurança
description:
KNOT is a Norwegian shipowner, the largest shuttle tanker operator in the world. As we manage our own fleet, contracts and crew, we give a unique development opportunity for our seafarers and employees. On top of that, we pride ourselves in being a company that values safety, innovation and growth for our employees.
Innovation, Credibility and Care are very important values for us.
This job opportunity is for a Safety Technician.
We are looking for professionals who are qualified, committed to joining our Brazil team, and who want to grow and collaborate with us and with our teams from around the world.
If you are hands-on, proactive and enjoy a challenge, join us!
Job challenges:
- Management of legal documents – PGR, PCMSO, ASO, LTCAT;
- Monitor, and enforce KNOT's HSEQ policies, procedures, and governing documentation;
- Monitor company activities to ensure compliance with regulatory, client, and internal HSEQ requirements;
- Ensure adherence to Brazilian Regulatory Standards (NRs) and applicable local legal requirements, supporting their correct application in the workplace;
- Manage the availability, distribution, and correct use of Personal Protective Equipment (PPE).
- Take part in investigations and analyses of work-related accidents, incidents, and near misses;
- Prepare technical reports, record findings, and communicate deviations, corrective actions, and lessons learned.
- Develop and support educational actions and safety campaigns related to occupational health and safety.
- Participate in HSEQ audits and inspections, both onshore and onboard vessels/facilities.
- Support internal and external inspections and follow up on action plans resulting from audits;
- Participate in emergency response drills and simulations;
- Support emergency response readiness and compliance with emergency procedures;
Requirements:
- Technical degree in Occupational Safety;
- Previous experience as an Occupational Safety Technician, preferably in the maritime/naval industry;
- Advanced English (frequent interaction with Norwegian colleagues and other cultures) – will be tested;
- Experience in the implementation of Brazilian Regulatory Standards (NRs);
- Intermediate Excel skills;
- Desirable: Bachelor's degree;
- Desirable: Experience with e Social system (Brazilian digital platform for labor, social security, and tax reporting).
Benefits we offer:
- Food allowance;
- Transportation allowance without discount;
- Health and dental plan at no cost;
- Life insurance;
- Private pension;
- Profit-Sharing;
- Well Hub Membership.
If you meet the requirements and are interested in being part of a company that values its professionals, offers development opportunities and an excellent working environment, apply now.
All our job openings are also available to people with disabilities.

title: Finance analyst - collection, finance
description:
About Voxy
Voxy, established in 2010, is an innovative language training platform designed to address the unique language requirements of global organizations. Aiming to boost productivity, encourage collaboration, and unlock human potential, Voxy has positioned itself as a worldwide leader in corporate language training. Voxy has built a strong foundation and a continually developing vision, assisting corporate clients in 150 nations through live language coaching by certified teachers and a vast selection of role-specific courses that address essential soft and technical skill deficiencies.
Currently, Voxy's influence reaches worldwide, with committed teams working in various locations such as the United States, Brazil, Chile, Mexico, Thailand, Malaysia, Spain, Italy, and Ireland. Initially concentrated on English language teaching, Voxy has expanded to provide various languages, such as Portuguese, Spanish, Italian, German, and French, serving a wide variety of learners.
We think that acquiring a language ought to be enjoyable, fulfilling, and a pathway to the finest experiences life presents. If you're on board, we would be happy to discuss.
You can find additional information about our values at this link (
The Impact You'll Have at Voxy
Growth brings complexity. This role exists to ensure our financial operations keep pace, reducing DSO, identifying risks early, and resolving payment issues before they escalate.
What You'll Be Doing:
Collections & Cash Application:
• Performs daily collection activities on overdue customer accounts through outbound calls, emails, and correspondence following established dunning schedules and escalation protocols.
• Monitors AR aging reports and prioritizes collection efforts based on balance size, days past due, customer risk profile, and strategic account importance.
• Investigates and resolves customer billing disputes by coordinating with Sales, AM/KAM, Billing, and Contract Administration teams; documents dispute details and resolution actions in the XERO/Salesforce system.
• Negotiates payment plans and settlement arrangements with customers within approved parameters; tracks compliance with agreed terms and escalates non-performing arrangements to the FP& A Manager.
• Applies incoming customer payments (checks, ACH, wire transfers) to open invoices in the AR sub-ledger; investigates and resolves unapplied cash, short payments, and overpayments.
• Prepares and sends customer account statements, past-due notices, and collection letters per company dunning policies.
• Processes customer write-offs and bad debt adjustments per approval policies; prepares supporting documentation for bad debt provisions.
Credit Analysis & Risk Management:
• Performs credit reviews for new and existing customers by analyzing financial statements, credit reports, trade references, and payment history; recommends credit limits and payment terms.
• Monitors customer credit exposure and concentration risk; flags accounts exceeding approved credit limits or exhibiting deteriorating payment behavior.
• Maintains accurate customer credit files and ensures compliance with internal credit policies and approval hierarchies.
Reporting & Analysis:
• Prepares weekly and monthly collection status reports, aging summaries, DSO analysis, and cash collection forecasts for management review.
• Tracks and reports on collection KPIs including collection effectiveness index, roll rates, promise-to-pay conversion rates, and bad debt write-off trends.
• Supports month-end AR close activities including revenue accruals, bad debt provisions, credit memo processing, and sub-ledger-to-GL reconciliation.
• Assists with ad-hoc analysis and special projects as directed by the FP& A Manager or Senior FP& A Analyst.
What We're Looking For:
• B. A/B. S. Degree - Accounting or Business Administration;
• 2+ years accounting and/or finance experience, with prior/current internship in accounting;
• Organized, process-oriented and meticulous attention to details;
• Comfortable working in an entrepreneurial environment and someone who is eager to learn, contribute as a team member and do more and to progress in the company;
• Advanced Excel skills. Experience with macros/VBA is a plus;
• Based anywhere in Brazil
• Capable of writing and reading in both English and Spanish
• Experience with tech company, preferably Enterprise Saas, is a plus.
Job Details:
• Gross Salary: R$110,500/year
• Working Hours: 8:00am - 5:00pm (GMT-3)
In addition to a rewarding job that that will directly impact how millions of students learn English, working here, you'll enjoy:
• Competitive salary (base/commission/bonus/equity)
• Great benefits: medical insurance, cell phone & wifi reimbursement, home office & wellness budget, team events
• Remote friendly work policies
• Professional development budget
• Language classes w/ Voxy & Fluentify
• Work with an awesome international team of super bright, creative, talented, and passionate individuals based around the world
• Time Zones: ET(Eastern Time), BRT(Brasilia Time), SAMT(Samara Standard Time), Central European Time (CET)
We believe in a workplace that is meant for everyone. Voxy is an equal opportunity employer.
Voxy believes that a creative, engaged and diverse team can transform the market and positively impact people's lives through education. We are sure that the mission of building the most effective way to learn English is done with a plurality of ideas and points of view, which is why we work to promote Diversity, Equity and Inclusion initiatives in our company.
In addition to training, benchmarking, and community partnerships, we also work in alignment with our internal DEI Committee.
As a reflection of our beliefs around inclusion in the workplace, our selection process has no restrictions; our goal is to assemble a diverse team that will help us be leaders in our market.
We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, or marital, veteran, or disability status. Learn more about our DEI initiatives and ERGs by clicking here.

title: Fx trader
description:
Role OverviewWe are seeking a highly skilled Emerging Markets FX Trader with deep expertise in African and/or Latin American currencies to join our global trading & liquidity team. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience managing illiquid and restricted FX markets, executing OTC and interbank trades, and designing robust hedging and liquidity frameworks to support high-volume cross-border payment flows. This role requires both strong trading capability and infrastructure expertise, including building and optimizing FX trading systems, hedging engines, and liquidity connectivity with banks, brokers, and OTC counterparties.
Key Responsibilities
FX Trading & Liquidity Management
Manage proprietary and flow-driven FX trading positions across Emerging Market currencies, with a focus on African (e.g., NGN, KES, ZAR, GHS) or LATAM (e.g., BRL, MXN, COP, ARS) markets.
Source and maintain deep liquidity relationships with banks, brokers, and OTC desks across relevant regions.
Execute spot, forwards, NDFs, swaps, and OTC trades to optimize execution quality and manage currency exposure.
Monitor market developments, capital controls, and liquidity dynamics across EM FX markets.
Hedging Strategy & Risk Management
Design and implement FX hedging strategies to manage corporate or client-driven exposures.
Optimize hedging efficiency across multiple liquidity venues including banks, ECNs, OTC desks, and crypto liquidity pools where relevant.
Develop models for dynamic hedging, inventory risk management, and spread optimization.
Monitor risk limits, Pn L, and exposure across currency books.
Trading Infrastructure & Systems
Work closely with engineering and product teams to build and enhance FX trading and hedging infrastructure, including:
Automated hedging engines
Liquidity aggregation systems
Smart order routing
Pricing and risk management tools
Integrate connectivity with banks, ECNs, and liquidity providers via APIs or FIX protocols.
Improve execution automation, latency optimization, and real-time exposure monitoring.
Market Development
Identify and onboard new liquidity providers and OTC trading partners across emerging markets.
Build pricing frameworks for illiquid currency pairs and support new corridor launches.
Contribute to the development of scalable FX infrastructure supporting global payments and settlement flows.
Requirements
Experience
5–10+ years of FX trading experience in Emerging Markets.
Strong experience trading African or LATAM currencies, such as:
Africa: NGN, KES, ZAR, GHS, EGP
LATAM: BRL, MXN, COP, CLP, ARS
Experience working at:
Global banks
EM FX trading firms
Payment / fintech companies
Crypto exchanges or market makers
Proven experience executing OTC and institutional-sized FX trades.
Technical Expertise
Deep understanding of:
FX market microstructure in illiquid markets
NDF markets and offshore hedging
Capital controls and FX regulatory frameworks
Hands-on experience building or optimizing:
FX trading systems
Hedging engines
Liquidity aggregation platforms
Familiarity with FIX connectivity, API-based trading systems, and algorithmic execution.
Skills
Strong quantitative and analytical capabilities.
Ability to operate in high-volatility and fragmented liquidity environments.
Strong network within EM FX liquidity providers and OTC trading desks.
Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience supporting high-volume cross-border payment flows or treasury operations.
Experience trading EM FX through both traditional banks and alternative liquidity sources.
Familiarity with stablecoin / crypto liquidity markets in emerging economies.
Background in building or scaling FX market-making operations.
Strong analytical and problem solving skills
Ability to operate across global teams and fast paced environments
Vision & Mission
OSL is the first SFC-licensed digital asset platform in Hong Kong and a Pay Fi innovator. Through stablecoin payments, cross-border settlement and global licensing, we are building the next-generation payments network. Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain's "killer app," with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption. The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2 B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners and cross-border corridors.
OSL holds or has acquired licences in Hong Kong, Japan, Australia, Bermuda and Indonesia, and is expanding into Europe, Brazil, Southeast Asia and Africa through acquisitions and licence applications. With OSL Pay and Stable X, we embed stablecoin settlement into bank accounts and card networks, support 150+ digital assets, and provide 24/7 fiat–stablecoin conversion. As a regulated pioneer with a startup mindset, we believe the future of payments will be driven by real adoption and scalable deployment, not technology narratives. We welcome builders who are passionate about crypto and payments to join us in shaping compliant, global payment infrastructure.

title: Salesforce crm specialist
description:
Position Overview:
As the Customer Relationship Management Specialist (CRM Specialist), you will support the day-to-day execution of the CRM function. You will be a key contributor in Salesforce Marketing Cloud (SFMC), partnering with Marketing, Operations, Contact Center, and Product to build and optimize journeys, automations, and campaigns that move clients from inquiry to booked appointment to loyal advocate.
This role sits within the Marketing team, working alongside peers across demand generation, digital performance, brand, and content.
Key Responsibilities:
Salesforce Marketing Cloud (SFMC):
Support the execution and optimization of campaigns within SFMC. Collaborate on building, testing, and deploying journeys and automations with a strong focus on the end-user experience and business impact.
Client Journey:
Assist in building and improving omnichannel journeys across email and SMS, supporting key moments from lead to booking to post-visit engagement, including reminders and follow-ups.
Data Segmentation and Hygiene:
Maintain audience segments and support data quality initiatives, including contact organization, suppression lists, and basic scoring logic to ensure a reliable database.
Testing & Quality Control:
Execute A/B tests on subject lines, send times, messaging, and journey logic. Document results and apply learnings to improve performance.
Performance & Reporting:
Support CRM reporting by tracking key metrics such as bookings, conversion rates, and engagement. Contribute to performance analysis and insights.
Operational Support:
Work cross-functionally with Marketing, Contact Center, and Product teams to identify and help resolve friction points in the client journey.
Platform Integrations:
Support the day-to-day functioning of SFMC in coordination with Salesforce CRM and other tools. Escalate issues and collaborate on solutions when needed.
Required Qualifications:
Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, or a related field (or equivalent professional experience)
3–5 years of experience in CRM, lifecycle marketing, or marketing automation roles, including Salesforce Marketing Cloud
Ability to work on-site at the company's headquarters at least 4 days per week
Preferred Qualifications:
Salesforce Marketing Cloud certification
Working knowledge of Salesforce CRM
Experience in multi-location services, retail, or health and wellness industries
Familiarity with booking or practice management systems
Experience with SMS marketing and omnichannel engagement
Basic understanding of Martech integrations and data structures
Experience creating or adapting content to improve engagement across the client lifecycle

title: Senior ruby on rails engineer
description:
About Stay FiStay Fi combines Io T and marketing technology for the vacation rental industry (think Airbnb hosts). With our product, vacation rental managers can create a meshable Wi Fi guest network with a custom-branded Wi Fi login page that collects guest information. Our software lets them monitor their network remotely and integrates with their marketing tools to help them build relationships with their guests and grow their business.
Over the past 8 years, we've built our business from the ground up without the help of large investors. This means we're growing a sustainable business and we run it independently. We're a small team so each team member has a big impact on our product and business. And we're creating tools that our customers truly love. About You
You're a senior full stack Ruby on Rails developer with 7+ years of professional experience building and shipping production applications.
You're a product-minded engineer who takes ownership. You think beyond each task / ticket and consider the broader impact of your technical decisions on the business.
You write expressive, readable, and maintainable code and hold yourself and others to a high standard through thoughtful code reviews.
You have a strong command of Rails conventions but know when and how to diverge from them pragmatically.
You're comfortable navigating and improving legacy codebases, not just greenfield projects.
You're curious about Io T, Wi Fi, and building sophisticated 3rd party API integrations.
You're energized by working on a small team where your decisions carry real weight. About the Role
Write full stack code using Ruby on Rails, Postgre SQL, Tailwind CSS, React and Java Script, and deploy it via Heroku, Azure and AWS.
Take ownership of large, complex projects: from scoping and architecture through to delivery in close collaboration with the CTO.
Identify and address performance bottlenecks, technical debt, and architectural weaknesses proactively.
Build and maintain robust API integrations with 3rd party software providers.
Lead by example in pull request culture; writing clear descriptions, giving constructive feedback, and raising the bar for the whole team.
Contribute to engineering standards, tooling decisions, and best practices as a senior voice on the team. Why Work at Stay Fi?
You'll work directly with the CTO and CEO on mission-critical projects with real ownership and autonomy.
Your experience and judgment will directly shape the technical direction of the product.

title: Chief revenue officer
description:
Chief Revenue Officer
The Opportunity
We're looking for a seasoned Chief Revenue Officer to help our client — an AI-powered logistics Saa S company — build and scale their US enterprise revenue engine from the ground up.
Our client is a Houston-based, seed-funded logistics platform founded in 2019. They bring consumer-app simplicity to enterprise logistics, unifying appointment scheduling, dock and yard management, and gate digitization for shippers, 3 PLs, and carriers.
They've built real product-market traction and are now ready to scale. That's where you come in.
The Role
Reporting directly to the CEO, you'll own the entire US enterprise revenue motion end-to-end — strategy, hiring, pipeline, forecasting, and expansion. This is a rare \"own the whole thing\" seat: you'll set GTM strategy, build the team, and personally drive early pipeline until that team is in place.
What You'll Do
Build and execute the US enterprise GTM strategy from scratch
Hire, onboard, and lead the full revenue organization — AEs, BDRs, and sales management
Personally carry and close strategic early enterprise deals while the team ramps
Own pipeline generation, forecasting, and revenue operations
Partner with the CEO on pricing, packaging, and market positioning
Establish the sales culture, process, and playbook for a company scaling from near-zero to multi-million in ARR What We're Looking For
Required:
15–20 years of revenue leadership experience at the CRO level
Demonstrated track record scaling revenue from near-zero to multi-million within US enterprise
Proven experience hiring, building, and leading revenue teams (AEs, BDRs, sales managers) — not a solo operator with a CRO title
Deep logistics or supply chain industry experience
Native-level English and executive-level presence
Willingness to provide 2–3 references from prior employers You'll thrive in this role if you:
Have reference-able revenue numbers you can point to from prior companies
Are energized by building from scratch rather than managing a mature org
Can toggle fluidly between strategy, recruiting, and rolling up your sleeves to close deals
Have operated inside or sold into US enterprise logistics, freight, or supply chain This is not the right fit if you:
Come from a mid-market or non-logistics Saa S background
Have primarily tactical experience (AE, sales manager) without true org leadership
Lead with CRM/pipeline theater rather than produced revenue
Have never built or managed a revenue team

title: Técnico em segurança
description:
KNOT is a Norwegian shipowner, the largest shuttle tanker operator in the world.
As we manage our own fleet, contracts and crew, we give a unique development opportunity for our seafarers and employees.
On top of that, we pride ourselves in being a company that values safety, innovation and growth for our employees.
Innovation, Credibility and Care are very important values for us.
This job opportunity is for a Safety Technician.
We are looking for professionals who are qualified, committed to joining our Brazil team, and who want to grow and collaborate with us and with our teams from around the world.
If you are hands-on, proactive and enjoy a challenge, join us! Job challenges: - Management of legal documents – PGR, PCMSO, ASO, LTCAT; - Monitor, and enforce KNOT’s HSEQ policies, procedures, and governing documentation; - Monitor company activities to ensure compliance with regulatory, client, and internal HSEQ requirements; - Ensure adherence to Brazilian Regulatory Standards (NRs) and applicable local legal requirements, supporting their correct application in the workplace; - Manage the availability, distribution, and correct use of Personal Protective Equipment (PPE).
- Take part in investigations and analyses of work-related accidents, incidents, and near misses; - Prepare technical reports, record findings, and communicate deviations, corrective actions, and lessons learned.
- Develop and support educational actions and safety campaigns related to occupational health and safety.
- Participate in HSEQ audits and inspections, both onshore and onboard vessels/facilities.
- Support internal and external inspections and follow up on action plans resulting from audits; - Participate in emergency response drills and simulations; - Support emergency response readiness and compliance with emergency procedures; Requirements: - Technical degree in Occupational Safety; - Previous experience as an Occupational Safety Technician, preferably in the maritime/naval industry; - Advanced English (frequent interaction with Norwegian colleagues and other cultures) – will be tested; - Experience in the implementation of Brazilian Regulatory Standards (NRs); - Intermediate Excel skills; - Desirable: Bachelor’s degree; - Desirable: Experience with e Social system (Brazilian digital platform for labor, social security, and tax reporting).
Benefits we offer: - Food allowance; - Transportation allowance without discount; - Health and dental plan at no cost; - Life insurance; - Private pension; - Profit-Sharing; - Well Hub Membership.
If you meet the requirements and are interested in being part of a company that values its professionals, offers development opportunities and an excellent working environment, apply now.
All our job openings are also available to people with disabilities.

description:
Atuar na prevenção de acidentes e doenças ocupacionais, garantindo um ambiente seguro e em conformidade com as normas legais (NRs). Inspecionar locais de trabalho, orienta sobre o uso de EPIs/EPCs, realizar treinamentos, investigar acidentes e elaborar documentos técnicos.
Principais Atividades e Responsabilidades:
Prevenção e Inspeção: Realizar vistorias diárias para identificar riscos, inspecionar máquinas, equipamentos e garantir o uso correto de EPIs (Equipamentos de Proteção Individual) e EPCs (Equipamentos de Proteção Coletiva).
Gestão de Riscos: Mapear riscos (físicos, químicos, biológicos, ergonômicos) e desenvolver planos de ação para mitigá-los.
Treinamentos e Cultura: Organizar e ministrar treinamentos sobre normas de segurança, prevenção de incêndios e primeiros socorros, promovendo uma cultura de segurança.
Documentação e Conformidade: Elaborar relatórios, laudos técnicos, investiga acidentes de trabalho para evitar repetições e assegura que a empresa cumpra a legislação trabalhista.
Apoio a Emergências: Coordenar planos de evacuação e atua diretamente em situações de emergência. Formação Necessária:
É preciso ter curso técnico em Segurança do Trabalho, e experiência comprovada em carteira, desejável em Industria.

title: Account manager
description:
LOVE startups and always dreamed of working in tech?
WANT to become a disrupter, tackling one of the world’s biggest problems?
BELIEVE you can use your skills to help change the world?
Oneday is a VC-backed Ed Tech company that supports aspiring entrepreneurs from all corners of society to launch their dream business, with expert support from a mentor, a deep curriculum of content, and a vibrant community of business founders.
We have raised $20 M+ in funding from the UK's and Silicon Valley's leading VCs. Our launch phase has been extremely successful and we have reached a stage to take the next step in driving further awareness and intent for our growing range of products.
We’re looking for Account Managers to join our inbound sales team and own the early-stage founder experience.
What you’ll do..
As an Account Manager, you’ll be responsible for managing warm inbound leads from start to finish:
Conduct high-quality discovery calls with founders who’ve already shown interest
Understand what they’re building, why it matters, and where they’re stuck
Clearly position Oneday’s programs and mentorship
Confidently handle objections and guide qualified founders to the next step
Book next-step calls and keep your pipeline clean and updated
Work in a high-volume environment (150–250 calls/day) while staying sharp
Track your performance and continuously improve conversion rates
This is not a passive customer success role.
It’s a performance-driven, ownership-heavy sales role where outcomes matter.
You’ll likely do well here if you:
Have experience in sales, account management, or customer-facing roles (startup experience is a big plus)
Are comfortable on the phone and can build rapport quickly
Think in terms of numbers, conversion rates, and improvement
Can stay organised and disciplined in a fast-moving environment
Take feedback well and apply it
Have strong written and spoken English skills
Are resilient, proactive, and take ownership of results
What you’ll get:
Unparalleled experience of working for a hyper-growth startup
Having fun and learning from your more experienced colleagues — serial entrepreneurs, investors and engineers
Fully remote working environment
Fantastic opportunity to get to know hundreds of founders and executives in the world on a first name basis

title: Risk management officer
description:
About Us
Established in March 2018, Bybit is one of the fastest growing cryptocurrency derivatives exchanges, with more than 70 million registered users. We offer a professional platform where crypto traders can find an ultra-fast matching engine, excellent customer service and multilingual community support. We provide innovative online spot and derivatives trading services, mining and staking products, as well as API support, to retail and institutional clients around the world, and strive to be the most reliable exchange for the emerging digital asset class.
Our core values define us. We listen, care, and improve to create a faster, fairer, and more humane trading environment for our users. Our innovative, highly advanced, user-friendly platform has been designed from the ground-up using best-in-class infrastructure to provide our users with the industry's safest, fastest, fairest, and most transparent trading experience. Built on customer-centric values, we endeavour to provide a professional, 24/7 multi-language customer support to help in a timely manner.
As of today, Bybit is one of the most trusted, reliable, and transparent cryptocurrency derivatives platforms in the space.
Key Responsibilities:

title: Landholder and reforestation delivery manager
description:
About Nature Co
Nature Co delivers nature-based solutions (Nb S) for investors, corporates and other purpose driven organisations to scale up action on climate change and biodiversity loss. We specialise in nature-based project development including reforestation, agroforestry, farmer managed natural regeneration and mangrove restoration. Nature Co has extensive expertise in working with local communities to protect and restore natural ecosystems through participation in the global voluntary carbon market.
Nature Co is currently implementing a large-scale reforestation project in Brazil for the generation of verified carbon credits.
We are a diverse, mission-driven team that values inclusion, integrity, and innovation. Nature Co is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to building an equitable and inclusive workplace for all.
 
Role and responsibilities
The Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager is the primary field-based interface with landholders, communities, reforestation contractors, and other local stakeholders for Nature Co’s projects in Brazil. This position will build and manage a pipeline of landholders interested in reforestation, lead outreach and onboarding, coordinate site inspections, lead the collection of relevant data required for carbon standard checks, and lead signature of landholder agreements. The role will also play a key role in ensuring compliance (contracts and carbon standards) as well as coordinate schedules between landholders and contractors for the implementation of reforestation activities. This will include confirming site readiness, conducting periodic field quality audits, documenting and tracking progress, and resolving issues that could delay delivery or degrade quality.
The role requires a strong combination stakeholder engagement and management experience, and a commitment to quality and impact. The role requires extensive travel and field work across Minas Gerais, Bahia and Espírito Santo.
Primary roles and responsibilities include:
Landholder engagement, onboarding, and pipeline management
Map priority municipalities and referral partner networks (city governments, co-ops, farmer associations, NGOs); plan and run outreach activities, events and information sessions.
Manage the landholder onboarding process (identify → qualify → onboard → contract), using CRM/trackers to keep status, documents and next actions current.
Prepare clear information packs (benefits, obligations, timelines) and respond to inquiries in a timely, professional manner.
Maintain ongoing landholder relationship management to support retention, satisfaction, and smooth site access throughout implementation. Eligibility, due diligence & agreements
Coordinate site inspections and initial diagnostics in consultation with other team members (parcel boundaries, vegetation status, access, water, risks).
Support land tenure verification and FPIC documentation
Lead closure of contract signatures.
Maintain organized repository of all landholder records within Nature Co’s data management system (land titles, eligibility documents, contracts, site maps, inspection notes, photos, consultation records).
Reforestation delivery enablement
Translate signed landholder agreements into implementation-ready site plans (site-specific scope, access instructions, constraints, schedule windows).
Align field schedules with landholders and contractors to ensure access, minimize disruption to farm activities, and maintain trust and cooperation.
Support in the delivery of field delivery progress from contractors by site (start/finish dates, activities completed, challenges, next steps), and escalate issues early (access, weather delays, input shortages, labor constraints).
Support in monitoring reforestation activities (during and post planting) and coordinate, where required, rapid response with contractors/landholders (grazing, fire risk, pests, drought stress). Stakeholder engagement and safeguards
Plan and document stakeholder consultations and community meetings in accordance with Nature Co policies and procedures (agendas, attendance lists, minutes, photos).
Support the team in the operation of the grievance mechanism: receiving grievances and responding in accordance with the Nature Co grievance mechanism.
Maintain landholder contact and ensure landholder information is kept up to date.
Coordinate access, for other project staff and contractors as required. Reporting
Lead or assist the development of formal monthly, quarterly, and annual project implementation reports for internal and external stakeholders in line with contract and/or carbon standard requirements.
Prepare ad hoc reports, documents, and presentations for internal and external stakeholders. Teamwork and culture
Support the management of a cross-functional, international team, fostering collaboration and ensuring that project milestones and goals are met.
Stay current on emerging best practices in Nb S and carbon projects; proactively share insights across the organisation and with partners.
Skills and attributes
To perform successfully in this role, you will have:
A minimum of five (5) years of experience in reforestation projects with direct contact with rural landholders and reforestation planting service providers.
Degree in forest engineering, agronomy, ecology, or environmental science.
Intermediate English and native Portuguese language skills
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage confidently across cultures and stakeholder groups.
Strong project management skills, including experience managing timelines, deliverables, and working across multidisciplinary teams.
A proactive, self-starting approach with the ability to anticipate problems, adapt quickly, and take initiative under limited supervision.
A collaborative mindset and ability to lead and motivate internal teams and external partners
Ability to provide strategic and technical guidance across complex, multi-stakeholder projects.
Strong organisational skills and attention to detail in documentation and reporting.
A positive, energetic personality with resilience and drive to see projects through to delivery.
Extensive travel within Brazil is a requirement to perform this position.
Location Remote, with residence in Minas Gerais, Espirito Santo, or Bahia
Submission instructions
Email CV and brief cover letter to with subject: Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager
Submission deadline: 30 March 2026

title: Senior customer success manager — google ads & linkedin ads

Scalix AI is a performance-focused Google Ads and Linked In Ads agency built on one principle: paid media should drive real business outcomes, not vanity metrics. Founded by a former 8-year Google veteran, we work with ambitious Saa S companies, B2 B brands, nonprofits, home services operators, and growth-stage businesses who expect more than dashboards — they expect partnership, strategy, and results.
We're small, sharp, and scaling. This role is central to how we grow. The Role
We're hiring a Senior Customer Success Manager who lives at the intersection of Google Ads expertise, Linked In Ads fluency, and high-trust client relationships. You'll own a book of business end-to-end — from kickoff through renewal — and be the strategic voice clients rely on when they want to know why the numbers are moving and what to do next.
This isn't a reporting role. This is a thinking-partner role. You'll build campaigns that actually ladder up to revenue, translate performance into narrative, and hold the line on strategy when clients push in unproductive directions. What You'll Own
Client relationships. You are the face of Scalix AI for your accounts. You lead weekly/bi-weekly calls, quarterly business reviews, and the hard conversations that come with managing paid media budgets.
Campaign strategy and execution. You build, optimize, and scale Google Ads (Search, PMax, Demand Gen, Display, You Tube) and Linked In Ads (Sponsored Content, Message Ads, Lead Gen Forms, ABM campaigns) across multiple verticals.
Storytelling through data. You turn performance data into a narrative the client's CEO, CMO, or founder actually wants to read. Numbers alone don't retain clients — meaning does.
Attribution and measurement. You set up clean measurement (GA4, Linked In Insight Tag, conversion APIs, offline conversion imports) and defend the integrity of attribution when the data gets messy.
Proactive optimization. You don't wait for the client to ask. You spot, flag, and fix.
Retention and expansion. You identify opportunities to expand scope and you catch churn signals before they become churn. What We're Looking ForRequired:
5–8 years of hands-on paid media experience, with meaningful time spent in both Google Ads and Linked In Ads (not just one with a side of the other)
Direct, in-platform experience with Fibbler
Proven track record managing client relationships as the primary point of contact — ideally in an agency or consultancy setting
Strong storytelling ability: you can write a QBR narrative, present on Zoom with confidence, and explain a CPA spike in a way that builds trust rather than erodes it
Deep technical fluency in campaign architecture, bidding strategies, audience segmentation, creative testing, and conversion tracking across both platforms
Comfort with attribution conversations — last-click vs. data-driven, view-through, offline conversion imports, CRM-integrated measurement
B2 B and Saa S paid media experience Bonus:
HVAC, home services, or nonprofit vertical experience
Familiarity with tools like Hub Spot, Salesforce, GA4, Looker Studio, Supermetrics, Hockey Stack, or similar
Linked In Marketing Labs certification and/or Google Ads certifications
Experience building SOPs, onboarding docs, or client-facing collateral Who Thrives Here
You treat client accounts like you own them, because at Scalix AI, you effectively do.
You have opinions and you can defend them — but you also know when to flex.
You're allergic to fluff. You'd rather say \"here's what's working, here's what isn't, here's what we're changing\" than hide behind a 40-slide deck.
You want to work on a team that moves fast, ships work, and treats paid media as a craft — not a commodity. What We Offer
Fully remote — work from anywhere that overlaps reasonably with North American client hours
Direct access to the founder and real input on how the agency is built
A portfolio of clients who actually want to be partnered with (we screen hard at the front door)
